section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes an experimental study investigating the impact of a daily gratitude writing exercise on loneliness and health in older adults over a 3-week period. The study found that within-person variability in gratitude predicted differences in loneliness and health, and the treatment group showed stronger cumulative effects. Loneliness was identified as a mechanism for gratitude's impact on subjective well-being and health symptoms.
